pk.context: 20 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

clues.kinetics: Absolute bioavailability has not been determined, but food does not influence absorption. About 94% is protein bound, and elimination is mainly fecal, around 61% of the dose, as metabolites.
clues.substance: Molecular weight 389.41. A crystalline solid, practically insoluble in water and very slightly soluble in ethanol.
clues.product: Three tablet strengths, 5, 10 and 20 mg, under an NDA. Steady state is reached within 5 days of once-daily dosing.
clues.safety: No boxed warning. Contraindicated with any organic nitrate and with guanylate cyclase stimulators; headache, dyspepsia and back pain are the most common reactions.
clues.indication: Erectile dysfunction, the signs and symptoms of benign prostatic hyperplasia, or both; it may start BPH treatment together with finasteride for up to 26 weeks.
clues.mechanism: Inhibits phosphodiesterase type 5, raising cGMP so that smooth muscle relaxes and blood flows into the corpus cavernosum; it has no effect without sexual stimulation.

tell: A 17.5-hour half-life and almond-shaped yellow tablets set this PDE5 inhibitor apart from its rivals.
